rows.body: Sample: [db-call-deadline @ cbeffe4f01] "boundedPgReadTxn:acquire(admin)" did not resolve within 5000ms (waited 5283ms). No acquire measurements were available for this call, so both causes are still open. Two causes present identically at this point — (a) the pool's resolved endpoint is unreachable and postgres.js is silently retrying its INITIAL connect forever without rejecting (WI-7097), or (b) the CLIENT pool's acquire queue is saturated while the server is perfectly healthy. Server capacity does NOT decide (b), so dev:service_health / pg_stat_activity looking fine is not evidence against it — check this process's own pcusp:<pool>:p<pid> rows and PAPERCUSP_DB_POOL_MAX before the endpoint (WI-7097).
